backend: Real native IPC and isolated SQLite, no mockIPC. 100k rows: two private synthetic float WAVs and 99998 metadata-only rows. No model inference or audible playback. Sources inserted after startup to avoid scanning metadata-only paths.
limits: One macOS ARM64 dev-test profile GUI observation; no before/after WebView comparison or cross-platform guarantee.
Metadata rows are synthetic; only two audio paths exist. Library operations and editor PCM/waveform rendering use real native IPC.
Per-process ps RSS and footprint have different accounting. PCM bytes include mmap-backed storage and must not be added to RSS. Do not sum process RSS as disjoint physical memory.
WebKit attribution uses newly appearing PIDs relative to the before-launch snapshot and validates their disappearance after stopping only this host.
Action-to-state samples include polling; IPC timing summaries are recorded separately. Canvas submission is not GPU completion.
No real audio-device playback, external models, saves to user files, app installation, release or publication.

reproduction.frontend: Normal Vite production build, replacing only main.ts final mount invocation with the private probe. No mockIPC, iframe or native source edits. Token and audio paths substituted into probe template in private build only.
reproduction.native: Compile cargo build --locked --no-default-features with TAURI_CONFIG for unique app.fonicca.performance-fixture identifier, private appDirectoriesOverride, localhost devUrl, incognito window and test-only focus permission. Refuse launch unless both private identifier and data root are present in copied binary. Restore normal debug build afterwards.
reproduction.fixture: Fresh temporary directory. Two synthetic 44.1kHz stereo float32 WAVs, 30 and 1200 seconds, the same decaying 220/330Hz signal as editor/benchmarks.rs. Settings watchFolders=false, autoplay=false, volume=0, analysisThreads=1. SQL metadata seed occurs after native startup migrates an empty private database. No existing sources are registered for scans.
